breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It explicitly repeated the user's error by stating 'Extrude a single cell in spanwise direction with front and back patches treated as walls.' For a 2D simulation in OpenFOAM, the front and back patches must be of type 'empty', not 'wall'.
